description: Repairs r-sort-3/create-keys-accdb: the one-INSERT-per-row loads into the unique-indexed LU, LU2 and LU3 used Database.Execute without options, so a refused row returned hr 0 and no error number was recorded. Asks, on a copy of fixture r-sort-3-keys-accdb (ACCDB) opened read/write: new tables LUR (unique index on (K, N)), LU2R ((K, N DESC)) and LU3R ((K)), each (S Counter primary key, ID, K, N), filled by one INSERT..SELECT per LK row ID 1 to 36 and then the repeated IDs 1, 5, 6 and 19, with dbFailOnError and DBEngine.Errors read after each; then the (S, ID) rows that survive and each table's index metadata.
